products.name: Privileged Access Workstation (PAW) for Cloud Administration — Commercial
products.short_description: Protect your admins where attacks start — deploy hardened Privileged Access Workstations for cloud administration, isolated from email/web and enforced by Conditional Access.
products.description:
Protect your admins where attacks start — deploy hardened Privileged Access Workstations for cloud administration, isolated from email/web and enforced by Conditional Access.

Admins browsing email and the web on the same device they administer the cloud from is how tenants get owned. This solution deploys Privileged Access Workstations (secured, Intune-managed, hardened Windows dedicated to admin work), enforces that privileged roles can ONLY sign in from a PAW via Conditional Access device filters, and integrates PIM so admin access is just-in-time from a clean device.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • PAW build — hardened, Intune-managed Windows dedicated to admin work
  • Security baselines, ASR, app control, and web/email isolation
  • Conditional Access — privileged roles require a compliant PAW (device filters)
  • PIM integration — just-in-time admin from the clean device only
  • Deployment, break-glass, and operations runbook

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Admins operating from clean, isolated, hardened workstations — privileged access impossible from a general-purpose or compromised device.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTPAW-DeviceTag.ps1 — safely set the PAW marker (extensionAttribute1 = PAW) on named pilot devices
    • ENTPAW-Discovery.ps1 — inventory privileged roles/holders, device compliance, CA device-filter policies, and the PAW marker
    • ENTPAW-Report.ps1 — surface privileged sign-ins from non-PAW / non-compliant devices (KQL or Graph fallback)
    • ENTPAW-Set-CAState.ps1 — safely flip the PAW device-filter Conditional Access policy between report-only and enabled
    • ENTPAW-Validate.ps1 — confirm the PAW compliance policy, device marker, and device-filter policy are pilot-ready

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
